stampGenerator.legalNote: Generated stamp images are not seals registered at a community service center (or, for companies, the registry office), so they cannot be used for contracts or registrations that require a seal certificate (인감증명서). Use your registered physical seal there, and for other documents check first whether the recipient accepts a stamp image.
stampGenerator.title: Stamp Generator
stampGenerator.description: Create Korean name seals, square company seals and corporate seals, then save as transparent PNG or SVG.
stampGenerator.emptyTextHint: Enter text above to generate a stamp
tipsList: Adding '인' to a 3-letter name makes 4 characters, laid out neatly in a 2x2 grid.
Characters read top-to-bottom, starting from the right column, like a real seal.
A corporate seal puts the company name on the outer ring and '대표이사인' in the center.
Save PNG at 1000px or more for crisp printing.
Don't like the ink pattern? Click 'Re-stamp' to regenerate it.
guideShapesItems: Round: the most common personal seal; name + '인' (4 characters) fits well.
Oval: a tall personal seal, good for 3-4 character names.
Square seal: common for companies and organizations; up to 12 characters in a grid.
Corporate seal: company name on the outer ring, '대표이사인' in the inner circle.
guideUsageItems: Use as a stamp image on documents (not for contracts or registrations that require a seal certificate).
Add a copyright mark to blog or SNS posts.
Apply a stamp effect to print materials or business cards.
Transparent PNG background works with Photoshop, MS Word, and Hangul.
